goalZh: 会用 was / were 问答过去的情况,简单评价一个周末
canDoZh: 能回答"你周末过得怎么样?",说说当时在哪儿、天气和感受

newItems.noteZh: 美国人周一见面几乎必问;回答 It was great! / Pretty good. / Not bad.。
last weekend 上周末、last night 昨晚、last week 上周;前面不加 in / on。
yesterday morning 昨天上午;但"昨晚"说 last night,不说 yesterday night。
th 是浊音 /ð/;How was the weather? 天气怎么样?
西雅图的秋冬很少有 sunny day,所以出太阳时大家都很开心。
boring 说事情无聊,bored 说人觉得无聊:The movie was boring. I was bored.。
美国年轻人的高频词,语气比 good、great 更强。
放在形容词前加强语气:It was so fun! 太好玩了!/ I'm so tired. 累死了。连接两句时 so 是"所以":I was tired, so I stayed home.。
I was home all day. 我一整天都在家;all weekend 整个周末。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Good morning, Lei! How was your weekend?
lines.zh: 早上好,磊!周末过得怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei

lines.zh: 棒极了!我周六去了一个万圣节派对。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: That's great! Were the costumes scary?
lines.zh: 太好了!大家的服装吓人吗?

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: And what about you, Marcus? How was your weekend?
lines.zh: 马库斯,你呢?周末过得怎么样?

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: It was boring. I was home all weekend.
lines.zh: 挺无聊的。我整个周末都待在家里。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: The weather was bad. It wasn't sunny at all.
lines.zh: 天气很糟,一点太阳都没有。

lines.speaker: laura
lines.text: Oh no! It was really cold last weekend.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I was so tired. I was home all day.
lines.zh: 我太累了,在宿舍待了一整天。

grammar.bodyZh: 说过去"是、在、怎么样",把 be 动词换成过去式:I / he / she / it 用 was,you / we / they 用 were(am、is → was,are → were)。否定在后面加 not:wasn't / weren't;问句把 was / were 提到前面:Were the costumes scary? —— Yes, they were.。问感受用 How was…?:How was your weekend? 回答 It was awesome! / It was boring.。过去的时间词:yesterday(昨天)、last weekend(上周末)、last night(昨晚),last 前面不加 in / on,"昨晚"也不说 yesterday night。中国学生常错:I was go to a party(was 后面不能直接跟动词原形,做过的事下一课学)。发音:was、were 在句子里弱读成 /wəz/、/wɚ/,一带而过;听别人讲周末时,用 Really? ↗、That's great! ↘ 回应,让对方知道你在认真听。

examples.text: How was your weekend? — It was awesome!
examples.zh: 你周末过得怎么样?——棒极了!
